lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately five vertical columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters (RGB ~210,210,210) arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the branchial slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a matrix of nodes across the central lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the mid-flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a highlight on the dorsal edge and a shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin displays a low-density distribution of diffuse, lower-intensity spots scattered across its lateral surface, with higher density near the leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, irregular white patch (lesion or scar) is visible on the upper flank, approximately three vertical stripe columns posterior to the final gill slit.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high spatial frequency of small, high-luminance points that do not follow the grid-like arrangement found on the trunk.
